assumptions.statement: System::well_formed: every edge targets a live coordinate; an Uncond coordinate has a diagonal seed, Both masks and no id/neg edge; an id/neg edge targets a Split coordinate
assumptions.not_proved: That the systems production will solve satisfy the predicate. Every generator assumes it via kani::assume in any_system / any_small_system.
assumptions.why_outside: It is the kernel's input contract. Systems are built by the Phase-B adapter from facts, not by the algebra, and no production code builds a guarded system today.
assumptions.b1_obligation: The dynamic driver enforces the same predicate when it builds a system. A system or coordinate that fails it is NO_GUARDED_EVIDENCE, never solved as-is. Required B1 control: an Uncond coordinate with an id edge, and an edge to a missing coordinate, are both rejected.

assumptions.statement: ElectionSystem::well_formed: every import edge targets a live coordinate
assumptions.not_proved: That the election systems production builds satisfy it: kani::assume in any_election_system / any_small_election_system.
assumptions.why_outside: Election systems are built by the Phase-B adapter from guards[] and calls[]; no production code builds one today.
assumptions.b1_obligation: An import edge whose callee has no coordinate (unresolved, R, or not first-party) is not an edge: the callee's election reads as None, never a guessed One(g).

assumptions.statement: A guard parameter is entry-value stable (G-V4): never assigned, incremented, taken by ref, or passed by ref/out in the method body

guarantor.what: BuildGuardedFacts emits a guards[] entry only for a stable by-value parameter, and an argument naming an unstable parameter is opaque, never param
guarantor.consumer: the guarded_facts sidecar, validated at the OwnIR doors; the first semantic consumer will be the B1 adapter
guarantor.on_violation: an unstable guard gets no entry (absence is the fail-closed signal, spec/OwnIR.md §5.2), so no Id/Neg edge can be formed from it

assumptions.note: The three gv4-* controls pin the LEGACY end-to-end record (KNOWN_FALSE_POSITIVE: ConsumesParam fabricates a release). They are production-seam witnesses of the hazard, not of a guarded path, which does not exist yet.

assumptions.statement: An id/neg edge relates the same logical guard: the caller's own stable parameter bound to the callee's elected guard parameter

guarantor.what: args are keyed by DECLARED parameter ordinal (named arguments resolved), and a stable parameter argument is param{source_param[, negated]} naming the caller's own declared ordinal; `!p` is the only negation recorded
guarantor.on_violation: a binding the producer cannot represent is opaque; an unresolved callee binds by source position with callee null and cannot name a declared ordinal

assumptions.b1_obligation: Form GuardBinding::Id/Neg only when the callee is resolved (callee != null), the argument at the callee's ELECTED guard ordinal is param{source_param}, and that source parameter is the caller's elected guard. Everything else is Const or Opaque. Required B1 control: an unresolved callee with a param argument at the guard position yields Opaque.

assumptions.statement: Uncond coordinates are diagonal: seeded as (t, t) and kept so
assumptions.not_proved: That production seeds Uncond coordinates diagonally. From that, K12a/K12b prove step and the lfp keep the invariant, and K6 assumes it at application.
assumptions.why_outside: Seed construction belongs to the adapter; the kernel proves preservation, not initialization.
assumptions.b1_obligation: Build Uncond seeds only through Cells::diag, validate WF, and apply an Uncond coordinate only through apply(Shape::Uncond, ...), which lowers the collapse.

assumptions.statement: Release-cell facts are internally consistent (G-S2/G-S3): must = a definite local release in the cell, may = a release behind a second condition, no = a kept path, ⊥ = nothing local; for the G-T2b claim, a released cell carries no forward edge
assumptions.not_proved: That each cell's seed is honest. The kernel README lists cell-local facts as trusted input, and K9/K11b/K11-today assume them.
assumptions.why_outside: Cell-local facts come from the CFG, not the algebra. The A2 sidecar does not carry them: B1 derives them from the legacy body joined with the sidecar (A15).
assumptions.b1_obligation: Derive seeds only through the A15 join; a coordinate with ambiguous seed facts is NO_GUARDED_EVIDENCE. A cell with both a local release and a forward is outside the G-T2b compatibility claim, and the shadow report must classify it that way, never as a refinement.

assumptions.statement: import and the edge transforms are only fed the declared GuardBinding / Transform semantics, never a P-037 interpretation made by the frontend

guarantor.what: the raw argument vocabulary is closed and interpretation-free (bool_const, null_literal, object_creation, param, var, call_result, opaque); fresh_owned, const-pos, id and neg cannot be spelled, and the schema is closed
guarantor.on_violation: the producer refuses to write a malformed facts file (exit 2) and a door rejects an unknown kind; kernel import maps anything but an exactly bound Id/Neg to None

assumptions.b1_obligation: Transform table: bool_const / null_literal / object_creation become ConstPos/ConstNeg relative to the callee's canonical guard orientation; param becomes Id/Neg under the A2 rule; call_result and opaque are Opaque in the solver. A call_result may select a cell only at application, after finalization, and only when the finalized return summary proves fresh (§10.2).

assumptions.statement: The solver step production runs is monotone
assumptions.not_proved: That production's step is the proved step. K3/K10a/K10e prove monotonicity for read, contribute, System::step and ElectionSystem::step at the bound.
assumptions.why_outside: No production driver exists, and the dynamic driver is not the bounded System (A12).
assumptions.b1_obligation: The dynamic driver computes a coordinate as seed ⊔ contribute(mask, read(transform, callee)) using the kernel's own read, contribute, Cells::join and import: a path dependency, never a re-implementation (A1 acceptance item 6). The kernel's cargo test runs over those same functions.

assumptions.statement: The solver visits every live coordinate (fair / full visitation)

guarantor.what: no production file calls a schedule-taking kernel API (solve_with, elect_with, lfp_chaotic), so production can only reach the full-sweep solve / elect or a driver bound by the obligation below
guarantor.consumer: every production call into the kernel solver
guarantor.on_violation: RESULT: FAIL in tests/run_tests.py (tests/test_p037_proof_boundary.py) on the pushing commit

assumptions.b1_obligation: The dynamic driver is a full sweep by construction: every live coordinate is recomputed each pass until none changes, as the legacy mos.rs loop does, and it takes no schedule parameter. #368 stays open as a defect of the generic schedule-taking API and is a mandatory blocker before that API is used anywhere in production.

assumptions.statement: Finalization precedes application: fin before select / collapse / lower (finding F2)

guarantor.what: the kernel's apply and lower finalize (⊥ → no) before they select, collapse or lower, by construction; a production file that imports the kernel may not lower or collapse cells except through apply
guarantor.consumer: every production application of a guarded summary
guarantor.on_violation: audit FAIL (F9); if apply or lower stop finalizing, the k7 twins go red (F5, --mutants)

assumptions.b1_obligation: Route every application through apply, and port the K7 witness ((must, ⊥) unselected lowers to plain) to the B1 seam as a production test (A1 acceptance item 4).

assumptions.statement: No raw ⊥ reaches application as semantic evidence: every ⊥ that fin turns into no is a solver seed, never a lack of information
assumptions.not_proved: Where a ⊥ came from. fin maps ⊥ to no (borrow), which is a positive claim; the kernel defines ⊥'s meaning (INF-L2, K9) but cannot see its source.
assumptions.b1_obligation: Only the solver seed is ⊥. A missing callee coordinate, a missing record or sidecar (A11), an unresolved callee (A10) and an ambiguous join (A15) are Unknown / NO_GUARDED_EVIDENCE, never ⊥, following the legacy mos.rs lookup that maps a callee with no summary to Unknown.

assumptions.statement: An unknown or unresolved callee cannot fabricate must

guarantor.what: an unresolved call target is recorded as callee null, sig null, first_party false, with arguments by SOURCE position; the record is kept and never guessed
guarantor.on_violation: no declaration can be named, so no Id/Neg binding can be formed (A2) and the callee reads as Unknown

assumptions.b1_obligation: An unresolved callee is an Uncond(Unknown) coordinate. Unknown absorbs under join and never lowers to consume (K7). G-T2a against today is claimed only without Unknown seeds (the K11-today hypothesis); with them, K11b's class 3 (unknown vs may) applies.

assumptions.statement: A missing functions[] record or a missing guarded_facts sidecar provides no positive evidence
assumptions.not_proved: Anything about a method with no record or no sidecar: it is outside the guarded fact domain (OWNER RULING §10.6).
assumptions.why_outside: The R boundary was accepted by ruling: new records would move the MOS, and a second carrier would change the frozen OwnIR layout.
assumptions.b1_obligation: Absence reads as NO_GUARDED_EVIDENCE, i.e. Unknown for any edge that targets it: never no-effects, borrow, unconditional, guard-irrelevant, must, id/neg or an eligible guard. record-absence-boundary becomes a Phase-B negative control, and a mutant drawing a positive conclusion from absence must turn it red.

assumptions.statement: The bounded Kani dimensions are not production dimensions
assumptions.not_proved: Any property beyond MAX_COORDS = 3 coordinates, MAX_EDGES = 2 edges and guard indices below 3 (the whole-solver harnesses use 2 coordinates with 1 edge). The pass bound MAX_COORDS·HEIGHT+1 is proved only at that size.
assumptions.why_outside: CBMC tractability (§10.4): the bounded System is the model-checker instance; production reuses the algebra through a dynamic driver.
assumptions.evidence_external: The plain-Rocq generic theorems (unbounded K10 and its pass bound, research branches #369/#370) are external research evidence, not a dependency of this gate.
assumptions.b1_obligation: The dynamic driver bounds its passes by n·HEIGHT+1 for n live coordinates. Exceeding the bound gives NO_GUARDED_EVIDENCE for the SCC: never a partial value, never a panic.

assumptions.found_by: B0 exploration: proof-boundary manifest amendment (§10.1 case 2)
assumptions.statement: A callee summary read from outside its SCC is finalized (⊥ → no) before any caller reads, collapses or selects it
assumptions.not_proved: The kernel models a single SCC, so composition across SCCs (the production driver's bottom-up order) is not modeled. Through an Opaque edge a raw (must, ⊥) collapses to must, while the finalized (must, no) collapses to may: finding F2 at the SCC boundary.
assumptions.why_outside: SCC decomposition and ordering belong to the driver, not the algebra.
assumptions.b1_obligation: Export only Cells::fin() values across an SCC boundary, as mos.rs does for scalars (param_val receives unwrap_or(Transfer::No) before any later SCC reads it). Required B1 control: a two-SCC shape whose callee has a residual ⊥ cell must not fabricate must at the caller.

assumptions.found_by: B0 exploration: proof-boundary manifest amendment (§10.1 case 2)
assumptions.statement: The callee coordinate an edge reads is the code that runs: calls[].callee is the statically resolved symbol
assumptions.not_proved: That a virtual, override, abstract or interface call executes the resolved body; the sidecar carries no dispatch fact.
assumptions.why_outside: This is an analyzer-wide assumption inherited from the legacy path: ConsumesParam and the MOS summary keying read the resolved body too. It cannot be discharged fail-closed from the A2 facts, because no fact says a call is virtual.
assumptions.phase_c_obligation: Before guarded summaries become authoritative (phase C), either add a dispatch fact (a case-5 OwnIR amendment) or obtain an owner ruling that accepts the inherited assumption. It does not block B0/B1, because B1 moves no verdict. INFERENCE: through a virtual call the guarded consume set stays within the legacy end-to-end consume set as long as ConsumesParam folds any-path disposal into a release, so the shadow does not widen it.
assumptions.b1_obligation: The B1 shadow report states that its refinement counts are conditional on static dispatch.

assumptions.found_by: B0 exploration: proof-boundary manifest amendment (§10.1 case 2)
assumptions.statement: The adapter places each relevant call and each eligible guard in the legacy body's structured CFG by a join on lines (the §10.5 call-site identity), and that is where the G-S4 masks and G-S2/G-S3 seeds come from
assumptions.not_proved: That the join is right. The masks and seeds are trusted kernel inputs and the A2 sidecar carries no branch placement; body if ops carry no column.
assumptions.why_outside: CFG derivation belongs to the frontend/adapter trusted-input boundary. B0 established that it has to be a join, not a sidecar field.
assumptions.b1_obligation: Fail-closed join. Attribute a sidecar call to a body op only when all of these hold: its form is statement or initializer (an expression-form call may be conditional); its statement_line has exactly one relevant call and exactly one non-structural op on that handle; and the line carries no if/while op. Place a guard only when exactly one if op sits on its site line. Every other case, including a call with no body op, is NO_GUARDED_EVIDENCE for every coordinate it touches. Required B1 controls are the B0 probe shapes in the note: a borrowing forward inside vs after a guarded if; two ifs on one line; `c && F(s)`; a call inside a catch block (no body op); `c ? F(s) : 0` (no record); a one-line for loop; `: base(s, keep)` (no body op).

assumptions.found_by: B0 exploration: proof-boundary manifest amendment (§10.1 case 2)
assumptions.statement: must / no / may describe normal-return paths only
assumptions.not_proved: Exceptional paths. The legacy body drops catch blocks (probe: a statement in a catch has no body op), so a release inside a catch that then returns normally is invisible to legacy and guarded alike.
assumptions.why_outside: Exceptional exits are P-036 vertical B, outside P-037.
assumptions.phase_c_obligation: Inherited from legacy and not widened by P-037, since both read the same body; record it in the phase-C shadow classification. A relevant call inside a catch (no body op) is NO_GUARDED_EVIDENCE under A15.
